name: TR-808
description: Michael Fischer's Roland TR-808 set: kicks, snares, hats, toms, congas and percussion, with kick and snare variations on bank B

name: Acoustic Kit
description: A recorded drum kit from VCSL with velocity layers: kick, snares, toms, hi-hat, cymbals, claps and tambourine

name: Hand Percussion
description: Congas, bongos, cajón, darbuka, frame drum, shakers and small percussion from VCSL, with velocity layers

name: Grand Piano
description: VCSL's Kawai grand, one sample every few keys over the whole keyboard; it plays from the keyboard and holds while a key is down

name: FM Electric Piano
description: The Yamaha TX81Z's FM piano from VCSL, a sample every four keys, for the whole keyboard

name: Mallets
description: Marimba, vibraphone, xylophone and glockenspiel from VCSL, split over the keyboard from low to high

name: Concert Harp
description: VCSL's concert harp, plucked mezzo-forte, over the whole keyboard; notes ring on after the key

name: Cinematic Hits & FX
description: Timpani, orchestral bass drum, gong, clash cymbals, tubular bells, wind chimes, ocean drum and other textures from VCSL
